official_name: MODIS Aqua Level-3 Mapped Daytime Sea Surface Temperature 4km Monthly (R2022.0)
citation: NASA Ocean Biology Processing Group (2022). MODIS-Aqua Level-3 Mapped SST Data Version R2022.0. NASA OB.DAAC, Greenbelt, MD, USA.
limitations: Infrared radiometer measures thermal skin layer (~10-20 µm depth), not bulk temperature.
Cloud cover obstructs optical/thermal retrieval; monsoonal periods experience missing observations.
Aerosol and volcanic ash contamination can cause localized cool biases if unmasked.

official_name: MODIS Aqua Level-3 Mapped Chlorophyll-a Concentration 4km Monthly (R2022.0)
citation: NASA Ocean Biology Processing Group (2022). MODIS-Aqua Level-3 Mapped Chlorophyll-a Data Version R2022.0. NASA OB.DAAC, Greenbelt, MD, USA.
limitations: Remotely sensed chlorophyll-a is an optical surface proxy; does not capture deep chlorophyll maxima.
Suspended inorganic sediment and CDOM in Case-2 coastal waters can bias optical retrievals.
Log-normally skewed distribution requires non-parametric Theil-Sen slope analysis.

official_name: SWOT Level-2 KaRIn Low Rate Ocean Sea Surface Height Anomaly
citation: SWOT Project Team (2023). SWOT Level 2 KaRIn Low Rate Ocean Products. Ver. 2.0. PO.DAAC, CA, USA.
limitations: SHORT RECORD (Launched Dec 2022). Not scientifically eligible for multi-decadal trend extrapolation.
Resolves sub-mesoscale ocean eddies (15-50 km); retained for contemporary mesoscale context only.

official_name: PACE OCI Level-3 Binned Ocean Color Phytoplankton Product
citation: NASA PACE Project (2024). PACE OCI Hyperspectral Ocean Color Product Suite. NASA GSFC, Greenbelt, MD, USA.
limitations: SHORT RECORD (Launched Feb 2024). Operational maturation and sensor cross-calibration ongoing.
Provides hyperspectral pigment identification for modern baseline comparison.

official_name: MODIS Terra Land Surface Temperature and Emissivity 8-Day L3 Global 1km
citation: Wan, Z., et al. (2021). MOD11A2 MODIS/Terra Land Surface Temperature/Emissivity 8-Day L3 Global 1km SIN Grid V061. NASA LP DAAC.
limitations: Thermal radiative surface skin temperature, distinct from near-surface 2-meter air temperature.
Cloud cover causes missing observations during June-August monsoon in Bangladesh.
Urban heat island effect distinct from rural agricultural canopy temperatures.

official_name: GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 1 month 0.1 degree x 0.1 degree (V07)
citation: Huffman, G.J., et al. (2023). GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 1 month 0.1 degree x 0.1 degree V07. NASA GES DISC, Greenbelt, MD, USA.
limitations: Multi-satellite gauge-adjusted estimation; heavy convective monsoon rainfall can exceed radar gauge caps.
High natural interannual monsoon variability necessitates multi-decadal record for monotonic trend tests.

official_name: MODIS Terra Vegetation Indices 16-Day L3 Global 1km
citation: Didan, K. (2021). MOD13A2 MODIS/Terra Vegetation Indices 16-Day L3 Global 1km SIN Grid V061. NASA LP DAAC.
limitations: Optical reflection index (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red); saturates in dense multi-canopy rainforests.
Agricultural cropping calendars (Boro vs Aman rice cycles) drive intense sub-annual seasonality.
